harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الله» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, operating like «إنّ», and «إله» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship"; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar; and «الحي القيوم» are two khabars of the Divine Name, nominative; and the clause «لا إله إلا هو» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «نزل» is a further khabar (predicate) of the Divine Name, in the position of the nominative. The preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object, i.e.: bound up with the truth; «مصدّقًا» is a second ḥāl of «الكتاب». «لما»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, because the governing word is secondary (farʿ), being an active participle; and «ما», the relative, is the object of «مصدقا», and the adverb «بين» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «قبل» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation; «هدى» is ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «كيف يشاء»: a non-jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: however He wills to form you, He forms you. «العزيز الحكيم»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هو العزيز» (He is the Mighty), and «الحكيم» is a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ; and the clause «هو العزيز» is a badal (substitute) of the pronoun «هو» in His saying «لا إله إلا هو».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «وأُخَر متشابهات»: a noun conjoined to «آيات», and «متشابهات» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «فيتبعون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين», in the position of the nominative. The clause «وما يعلم تأويله إلا الله» is resumptive. The wāw in His saying «والراسخون» is resumptive, «الراسخون» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يقولون» is its khabar; the clause «كل من عند ربنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «وما يَذَّكَّر إلا أولو الألباب».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك», and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the response to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «ليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جامع»; the clause «لا ريب فيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم». «ميعاد» is originally «مِوْعاد», from «الوعد»; the wāw was vowelless and the letter before it had a kasra, so it was changed into a yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيئا», and «شيئا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: an availing, little or much. The clause «وأولئك هم وقود النار» is conjoined to the clause «لن تغني», in the position of the nominative, and the clause «هم وقود» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: His saying «كدأب آل فرعون»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: their way is like the way of…. The clause «دأبهم كدأب» is resumptive. And the clause «فأخذهم الله» is conjoined to the clause «كذبوا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «وبئس المهاد»: the wāw is resumptive, «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb of blame, «المهاد» is its fāʿil (agent), and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: «جهنم» (Hell); and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «التقتا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فئتين». «فئة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «إحداهما» (one of them), and the clause «إحداهما فئة» is a second naʿt of «فئتين»; the clause «تقاتل» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of «فئة»; and the clause «يرونهم» is a naʿt of «أخرى». His saying «وأخرى»: mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma because of impossibility, and «كافرة» is khabar; «مثليهم» is an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) with the yāʾ because it is dual; and the seeing is visual.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذهب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «القناطير»; the clause «ذلك متاع» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «والله عنده حسن المآب»; and the clause «عنده حسن» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الله».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من ذلكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير», and «كم» is a particle of address. The clause «للذين اتقوا جنات» is explicative of the "better", with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رضوان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالعباد» is attached to «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «الذين» is a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «العباد». The clause «فاغفر» is conjoined to the clause «آمنّا», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «الصابرين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الذين يقولون», genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; when attributes are repeated, it is permitted to conjoin some of them to others, even if the one qualified is a single one. The preposition and its genitive noun «بالأسحار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the active participle «المستغفرين».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنه لا إله إلا هو» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ. The first clause of divine transcendence is the khabar (predicate) of «أنّه», and the second is resumptive; and His saying «العزيز الحكيم»: two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «الله العزيز» (Allah is the Mighty); and the clause «الله العزيز» is a badal (substitute) of «هو» in His saying «لا إله إلا هو», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وما اختلف ...» is resumptive; «ما» is maṣdar-forming in His saying «من بعد ما جاءهم», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi; and «بَغْيًا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «ومن اتبعن»: a relative noun conjoined to the tāʾ in «أسلمت»; this conjunction is permitted because of the presence of a separator; the verb is past, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun «هو». «تَوَلَّوا»: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which was elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters after the yāʾ was made vowelless, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يقتلون»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الناس» is attached to a ḥāl of the wāw in «يأمرون». «فبشّرهم بعذاب»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) because the relative noun contains the sense of a condition, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «أولئك الذين» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause «وما لهم من ناصرين» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; and «ناصرين» is a noun genitive with the yāʾ in form, nominative in position, as mubtadaʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «يُدْعَون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الذين أوتوا», and the clause «وهم معرضون» is a ḥāl; the ḥāl from the indefinite «فريق» is permitted because it is joined with the wāw and because «فريق» is qualified.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أنَّ» and what follows it is in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك»; ما كانوا «a relative noun, fāʿil (agent)» غرَّ". [Translator's note: the end of this entry is garbled in the source, with the quotation marks misplaced; translated as it stands. The intended sense is presumably: «ما كانوا» — «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil of «غرَّ».]

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), its governing word being implied (muqaddar), i.e.: «يصنعون» (they will do). «إذا»: a pure adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «يصنعون». The clause «ووُفِّيت كل نفس» is conjoined to the clause «لا ريب فيه», and the linking element is implied, i.e.: every soul in it. And the clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The origin of «اللهم» is «يا الله»: the vocative particle was elided and replaced by the doubled mīm; so it is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the mīm is for compensation; and «مالك» is a badal (substitute) of «اللهم», accusative according to its position. The clause «تؤتي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «بيدك الخير».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «لا» is prohibitive and jussive-governing, and the verb is jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn, and given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; the preposition and its genitive noun «مِن دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتخذ»; the clause «ومن يفعل ذلك» is parenthetical; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شيء». His saying «إلا أن تتقوا منهم تقاة»: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: the believer does not take the disbeliever as a protector for any reason whatsoever except for outward guarding; the exception is emptied (mufarragh) for the mafʿūl li-ajlihi, and its governing word is «لا يتخذ». His saying «تقاة»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being «اتقاءً». The clause «يحذركم الله» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «وإلى الله المصير».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في صدوركم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ويعلم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله على كل شيء قدير»; the preposition and its genitive noun «على كل» is attached to «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «يوم تجد»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر يوم» (remember the day), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما», and «محضرًا» is a ḥāl of «ما». His saying «وما عملت من سوء»: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «من سوء» is attached to a ḥāl of «ما». «لو» is a particle of impossibility due to impossibility, and it is not maṣdar-forming after «ودَّ», because a maṣdar-forming particle does not enter upon its like; the interpreted maṣdar from «أنَّ» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» (it were the case), and the apodosis of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: «لَسُرَّت» (she would be pleased); the clause «وما عملت» is resumptive, and the clause «تودُّ» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما». The clause «ويحذركم الله» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله رءوف بالعباد».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «ذرية»: a badal (substitute) of «آدم» and those conjoined to him; «بعضها» is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the preposition and its genitive noun «من بعض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); and the clause «بعضها من بعض» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ذرية».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «إذ قالت»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر». «محرَّرًا»: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; and the clause «فتقبَّل» is conjoined to the clause «إني نذرت», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «والله أعلم» is parenthetical, the clause «وليس الذكر كالأنثى» is conjoined to the parenthetical one, and the clause «وإني سميتها» is conjoined to the clause «إني وضعتها».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «كل» is an accusative adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وجد», and «ما» is maṣdar-forming and temporal, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: every time of entering; the clause «وجد» is resumptive; the clause «دخل» is the ṣila of the relative particle, with no grammatical position; the clause «قال» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His saying «أنّى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place meaning "from where", attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «لك» is attached to the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached; and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «هنا» is a demonstrative, an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دعا»; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. The clause «قال» is explicative of the supplication, and the clause «هب لي» is resumptive, the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «يصلي» is a second khabar (predicate). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الله يبشرك» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ; «مصدقًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يحيى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بكلمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مصدقًا»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة». His saying «وسيّدًا»: conjoined to «مصدقًا»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الصالحين» is attached to a naʿt of «نبيًا».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «أنَّى»: an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). «يكون» is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun «لي» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «يكون». «غلام»: the noun of «يكون», nominative. The clause «وقد بلغني» is a ḥāl clause, and the clause «وامرأتي عاقر» is conjoined to the ḥāl clause, in the position of the accusative. His saying «كذلك الله»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: Allah does what He wills, a doing like that doing. The demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi, and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تكلم» is the khabar (predicate) of «آيتك». His saying «ثلاثة أيام»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تكلم», and «رمزًا» is a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) excepted, because a gesture is not of the genus of speech; the clause «واذكر ربك» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «كثيرًا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: much remembrance.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun, object of an implied «اذكر», and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «نوحيه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الغيب». «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. His saying «أيّهم»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «أيهم يكفل» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the basis that «يُلقون» is made to include the sense of «ينظرون» (they look to see). The first clause «وما كنت لديهم» is conjoined to the clause «ذلك من أنباء الغيب», while the second clause is conjoined to the first clause «ما كنت لديهم»; and the clause «يختصمون» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «وجيهًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عيسى», and the preposition and its genitive noun after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the preposition and its genitive noun «من المقربين» is attached to an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl conjoined to «وجيهًا», i.e.: and being among those brought near.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ويكلم» is conjoined to the preceding implied single-word ḥāl (circumstantial). His saying «كهلا»: a noun conjoined to the preceding implied ḥāl; and the preposition and its genitive noun «ومن الصالحين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl conjoined to «وجيهًا».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «أنَّى» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition and its genitive noun «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «يكون»; and the clause «ولم يمسسني» is a ḥāl clause, in the position of the accusative. «كن فيكون»: a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being the pronoun «أنت»; the fāʾ is resumptive, and the verb with it is a complete imperfect; and the clause «يكون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «فهو يكون» (and it is), and the clause «فهو يكون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: His saying «ورسولا»: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb, its implied form being «ويجعله رسولا» (and He will make him a messenger), and the preposition and its genitive noun after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) it. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنّي» and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The second interpreted maṣdar «أني أخلق» is a badal (substitute) of His saying «آية». His saying «كهيئة الطير»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: I create for you a shape like the shape of a bird. The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: His saying «ومصدقًا»: a noun conjoined to what «بآية» in the preceding verse is attached to, the implied form being: I have come to you bringing a sign and confirming. His saying «لأحل»: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e.: «وجئتكم لأحلَّ» (and I have come to you to make lawful); the clause «جئتكم» is conjoined to the implied «جئتكم», in the position of the nominative. And the clause «فاتقوا» is conjoined to the clause «جئتكم».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: His saying «فاعبدوه»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause «فاعبدوه» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله ربي». And the clause «هذا صراط» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «إلى الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in «أنصاري», and the clause «آمنا» is a second khabar (predicate) of «نحن».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «فاكتبنا» is conjoined to the clause «واتبعنا», with no grammatical position. «مع» is an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اكتبنا».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «والله خير» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The adverb «فوق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جاعل». And the clause «فأحكم بينكم» is conjoined to the clause «إليَّ مرجعكم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «ناصرين» is a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as mubtadaʾ (subject); it is made genitive by the redundant (zāʾida) «من»; and the clause is conjoined to the clause «أُعَذِّبهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «فيوفيهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», and the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «أجورهم» is the second object. The clause «والله لا يحب الظالمين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الآيات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «نتلوه».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «خلقه» is explicative, with no grammatical position; the clause «فيكون» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هو», and the clause «فهو يكون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: His saying «فلا تكن من الممترين»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the preceding resumptive clause, and the linking element is implied, i.e.: of those who doubt it; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الممترين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: His saying «ما جاءك»: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi. His saying «تعالوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The verb «نَدْعُ»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, the sign of its jussive being the elision of the weak letter. The preposition and its genitive noun «على الكاذبين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: His saying «وما من إله إلا الله»: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negating and inoperative, «من» is redundant (zāʾida), «إله» is a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is implied (muqaddar): «لنا» (for us); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), «الله» is a badal (substitute) of the position of «من إله», nominative; and the clause «وما من إله إلا الله» is conjoined to the clause «إنّ هذا لهو القصص». And the clause «وإن الله لهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause «ما من إله إلا الله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «تعالوا» is resumptive. «سواء»: a genitive naʿt (adjective); it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), and therefore it was not made feminine. «بيننا»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (سواء). And the maṣdar «ألا نعبد» is the khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject) implied as «هي».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: His saying «لِمَ تحاجون»: the lām is a preposition, «ما» is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn implied on the elided alif, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تحاجون»; the elision of the alif is obligatory because the preposition enters upon it. The clause «وما أنزلت التوراة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, in the position of the accusative. And the clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «هاأنتم»: «ها» is for drawing attention, and «أنتم» is a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «هؤلاء»: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, accusative by way of specification (ikhtiṣāṣ); and the clause «حاججتم» is khabar (predicate). The clause «فلِمَ تحاجُّون» is conjoined to the clause ها أنتم «حاججتم», with no grammatical position. And the clause «وأنتم لا تعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «والله يعلم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «ولكن كان» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: «لو» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لو يضلونكم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). And the clause «وما يشعرون» is conjoined to the clause «وما يضلون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «لم»: the lām is a preposition, «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تكفرون»; its alif was elided because it is made genitive; the clause «وأنتم تشهدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تكتمون».

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «وجه النهار»: an accusative adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا». And the clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «قل إنَّ الهدى هدى الله» is parenthetical. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يُؤتى أحد» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear of the giving; and the meaning is: and do not believe anyone except one who comes with the like of your religion, for fear that someone be given prophethood like what you were given, and for fear that they argue against you before their Lord by your having affirmed them.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «يختص» is a third khabar (predicate) of the Divine Name; the clause «والله ذو الفضل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. «إلا ما دمت»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), «ما» is maṣdar-forming and temporal, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ما دمت» is accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤدِّه». The preposition and its genitive noun «عليه» is attached to «قائما». The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم قالوا» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate). And the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «بلى» is a particle of answer, and «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «فإن الله يحب» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the link between the condition and the apodosis is the generality.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «أولئك لا خلاق» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «إنّ». The clause «لا خلاق لهم» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك». The clause «ولا يكلمهم الله» is conjoined to the clause «لا خلاق لهم». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «يزكيهم».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The lām in «لفريقا» is for emphasis. His saying «وما هو من الكتاب»: the wāw is circumstantial, and «ما» is negating, operating like laysa, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وما هو من عند الله» is a ḥāl clause. And the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤتيه» is the noun of «كان», and the preposition and its genitive noun «لبشر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان». The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ in «لي». The clause «ولكن كونوا» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, i.e.: but he says: be. And the maṣdar «بما كنتم» is genitive, attached to «ربانيين».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تتخذوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ. «بعد» is an accusative adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأمر», and «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «أنتم مسلمون» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, object of an implied «اذكر». «لما آتيتكم»: «لما»: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath contained in His saying «ميثاق», because it takes the role of an oath; «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «آتيتكم» is the ṣila (relative clause), and the returning pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: «آتيتكموه» (I gave you it). The preposition and its genitive noun «من كتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». The clause «ثمّ جاءكم» is conjoined to «آتيتكم», and the link that ties it to what precedes is achieved by the overt noun, namely «لما معكم», since it applies to His saying «لما آتيتكم». «لما»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle. His saying «لتؤمنُنَّ»: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; the verb is originally «تُؤمنونَنَّ», so it is nominative by the presence of the nūn, which was elided because of the succession of like letters; then the wāw was elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the implied wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause is the answer to an implied oath, and the clause «والله لتؤمنن» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «لما», in the position of the nominative. The clause «فاشهدوا» is the apodosis of an implied condition, in the position of the jussive, i.e.: if you affirm, then bear witness. And the clause «وأنا معكم من الشاهدين» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive; the hamza was put first because it necessarily takes the head of the clause; «غير» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وله أسلم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. «طوعًا»: an accusative ḥāl; and the clause «وإليه يرجعون» is conjoined to the clause «وله أسلم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «لا نفرّق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النبيون», and the clause «ونحن له مسلمون» is conjoined to the clause «لا نفرق», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «ومن»: the wāw is resumptive, «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «غير»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; «الإسلام»: muḍāf ilayhi. «دينًا» is an accusative tamyīz (specification). And the clause «وهو من الخاسرين» is conjoined to the apodosis clause, in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «يهدي» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الرسول حق» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ. The clause «وجاءهم البينات» is conjoined to the clause «شهدوا», and the clause «والله لا يهدي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «أولئك» is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. «جزاؤهم» is a second mubtadaʾ, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن عليهم ...» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «جزاؤهم»; the clause «جزاؤهم أنّ عليهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of «أولئك»; and His saying «أجمعين»: tawkīd (emphasis), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «لا يخفّف عنهم العذاب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «خالدين». And the clause «ولا هم ينظرون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يخفف العذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «فلن يُقبل»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), by likening the relative to the condition; «لن» governs the accusative, and the verb after it is passive, accusative; «ملء» is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «ذهبًا» is an accusative tamyīz (specification). «ولو افتدى»: the wāw is circumstantial, conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: it will not be accepted from any of them in any state, even in this state; this is for exhausting the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes. The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is resumptive. The clause «لهم عذاب» is khabar (predicate), and the clause «وما لهم من ناصرين» is conjoined to the clause «لهم عذاب», in the position of the nominative. And «ناصرين» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: His saying «وما تنفقوا من شيء»: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». And the clause «وما تنفقوا» is conjoined to the clause «لن تنالوا».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «إلا ما حرّم»: «إلا» is a particle of exception, «ما» is a relative noun excepted from the noun of «كان», and it is a joined (muttaṣil) exception. The clause «فأتوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful, then bring. And the clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The clause «فاتبعوا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. His saying «حنيفا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم»; the ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permitted because the muḍāf is like a part of it. The clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the single word «حنيفاً», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «مباركاً»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of «وُضِع» implied after «للذي», and not of the pronoun of the mentioned verb, so that the ḥāl and the one it describes are not separated by an extraneous element, which is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ». The preposition and its genitive noun «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «مقام إبراهيم» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «منها» (among them). The clause «منها مقام» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». The clause «ومن دخله» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ولله على الناس حج البيت». His saying «من استطاع»: a badal (substitute) of part from whole, and the linking pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: «منهم» (of them).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The clause «لِمَ تكفرون» is resumptive, the response to the vocative. The clause «والله شهيد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «تبغونها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تصدون». «عِوَجاً» is an accusative ḥāl. The clause «وأنتم شهداء» is a ḥāl clause, and the clause «وما الله بغافل» is resumptive; «ما» is negating, operating like laysa, the bāʾ in «بغافل» is redundant (zāʾida), and His saying «عمَّا تعملون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غافل».

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «يا»: a vocative particle; «أيها» is the one addressed, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative, and «ها» is for drawing attention; «الذين» is a relative noun, ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي». The conditional clause is resumptive. «كافرين» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because «يردُّوكم» means «يُصَيِّروكم» (make you).

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The wāw is a conjunction; «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تكفرون». The clause «تكفرون» is conjoined to the preceding response to the vocative. The clause «وأنتم تتلى» is a ḥāl clause, and the clause «وفيكم رسوله» is conjoined to the clause «وأنتم تتلى»; «من» in His saying «من يعتصم» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يعتصم» is khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «حق» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ولا تموتُنَّ»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive and jussive-governing; the verb is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn; the wāw, elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The clause «وأنتم مسلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نعمة»; His saying «إذ كنتم»: an adverb of time attached to the preceding ḥāl. «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: Allah makes clear a making clear like that; and «ذا» is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «يبين» is resumptive. And the clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «أولئك هم المفلحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «يوم»: an accusative adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, its implied form being «يُعَذَّبون» (they will be punished); the governing word is not {عَذَابٌ}, because it is qualified; and the implied clause «يعذَّبون» is resumptive. The clause «أكفرتم» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, which is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», i.e.: then it will be said to them: did you disbelieve? The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بما كنتم» is genitive, attached to «ذوقوا». The clause «فذوقوا» is resumptive within the scope of the implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: His saying «ففي رحمة»: the fāʾ is linking, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». And the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent pronoun in the khabar «مستقرون» (abiding).

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The clause «نتلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات الله». The clause «وما الله يريد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «للعالمين»: the lām is strengthening and redundant (zāʾida); «العالمين»: a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ظلما».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «تأمرون» is in the position of the accusative as a second khabar (predicate) of «كان». The noun of «كان» is a pronoun referring to the maṣdar (verbal noun) indicated by its verb, i.e.: belief would have been. The clause «منهم المؤمنون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the clause «وأكثرهم الفاسقون» is conjoined to the clause «منهم المؤمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: «إلا أذى»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: except the harm of annoyance. His saying «الأدبار»: second object, accusative. «ثم» is a particle of resumption, and the verb after it is nominative by the presence of the nūn, and the clause is resumptive. «ثم» is not a conjunction, because the verb after it is nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «أينما ثُقفوا»: a conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ثُقفوا»; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes. The clause «أين ما ثُقفوا ذلُّوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His saying «إلا بحبل»: a particle of exception from the most general of states, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial), implied as «كائنين» (being), i.e.: they are humiliated in all states except being in the state of their holding fast to the covenant of Allah. The clause «ذلك بأنهم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate). The preposition and its genitive noun «بغير حق» is attached to a ḥāl of the wāw in «يقتلون». «ما» in His saying «بما عصوا» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar. And the clause «عصوا» is the ṣila of the relative particle, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: «سواءً» is the khabar (predicate) of laysa; it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), therefore it may be predicated of one and of more than one. The clause «من أهل الكتاب أمة» is resumptive. The clause «يتلون» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «أمة», and the plural is with regard to the community. The clause «هم يسجدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يتلون». His saying «آناء»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتلون»; its singular is «أَنَى».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «يؤمنون» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in {يَتْلُونَ}. And the clause «وأولئك من الصالحين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: The wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the verb is jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn. The preposition and its genitive noun «من خير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». His saying «فلن يكفروه»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the verb contains the sense of «يُحْرَموا أجره» (be deprived of its reward), so it is transitive to two objects: the first is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the second is the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولادهم», i.e.: being in place of Allah; and «شيئاً» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: an availing, little or much. The clause «وأولئك أصحاب النار» is conjoined to the clause «لن تُغني», in the position of the nominative. And the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl of «أصحاب النار».

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «كمثل ريح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «مثل», and the clause «فيها صر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ريح». His saying «ولكن أنفسهم يظلمون»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), «أنفسهم»: a fronted object of «يظلمون»; the clause «وما ظلمهم الله» is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن أنفسهم يظلمون» is conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمهم الله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «لا يألونكم» is resumptive, and likewise the clauses «ودّوا», «بدت البغضاء» and «بيّنّا»; making these clauses a naʿt (adjective) is weak, because they were forbidden to take disbelieving intimates, and restriction by a qualification implies that taking them is permitted when these things are absent. The clause «إن كنتم تعقلون» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ما عنتّم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: they wish your distress. And «ما» in His saying «ما تخفي» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). And the clause «إن كنتم تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: «ها» is for drawing attention, «أنتم» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أولاء» is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «أعني» (I mean); and the clause «تحبونهم» is khabar (predicate). His saying «خَلَوا»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif, which was elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). And the clause «وإذا خَلَوا عضُّوا» is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: His saying «لا يضركم»: the verb is jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn, and this ḍamma on the rāʾ is a vowel of harmony (itbāʿ); the original form, with the doubled letter separated, is «يَضُرْرْكم», the second sukūn being for the jussive; then it was given the vowel nearest to it, namely the ḍamma on the preceding letter, so it is jussive by implication, and it was given the ḍamma because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; this is one of three ways of vowelling that apply to the jussive doubled verb. His saying «شيئاً»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a harm, little or much.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر»; the clause «غدوت» is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause «تبوئ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ in «غدوت». His saying «مقاعد»: second object of the verb «تبوئ».

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: His saying «إذ همّت»: a badal (substitute) of the preceding «إذ غدوت». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تفشلا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); His saying «والله وليهما»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). His saying «وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون»: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb after them; the preposition and its genitive noun was put first for exclusivity (ikhtiṣāṣ); the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is for command; and the clause «فليتوكل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: The clause «ولقد نصركم الله» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد نصركم» is the answer to an implied oath; the clause «وأنتم أذلة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and the clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: «إذ تقول»: a badal (substitute) of the preceding {إِذْ هَمَّتْ}. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يمدّكم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يكفي», and His saying «منزلين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الملائكة».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: His saying «من فورهم هذا»: the demonstrative is a naʿt (adjective) of «فورهم». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «خمسة». And His saying «مسومين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الملائكة».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: His saying «بشرى»: second object. His saying «ولتطمئن»: the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, conjoined to «بشرى»; it was made genitive because the condition of the agent being the same is not met, for the agent of the making is Allah, and the agent of the reassurance is the hearts; and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل». And the clause «وما النصر إلا من عند الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: «ليقطع»: the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن», optionally implied; the preposition and its genitive noun formed from the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being «أمدّكم» (He reinforced you). The clause «أمدّكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الذين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «طرفاً». His saying «فينقلبوا»: conjoined to «يكبتهم», accusative by the elision of the nūn; and His saying «خائبين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The clause «ليس لك من الأمر شيء» is parenthetical. The clause «أو يتوب» is conjoined to the clause {فَيَنْقَلِبُوا}, with no grammatical position. And the clause «فإنهم ظالمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The clause «يغفر» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «والله غفور».

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: «أضعافا» is ḥāl (circumstantial), «مضاعفة» is a naʿt (adjective). And the clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: The clause «عرضها السماوات» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «أعدَّت» is a second naʿt of «جنة».

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: «والكاظمين»: a noun conjoined to the relative noun, genitive with the yāʾ, and «الغيظ» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle. The preposition and its genitive noun «عن الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «العافين».

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause «ومن يغفر الذنوب إلا الله» is parenthetical, and «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «يغفر» is khabar (predicate), «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «الله» is a badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in «يغفر». The clause «ولم يُصِرُّوا» is conjoined to the clause «استغفروا», with no grammatical position. And the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يُصِروا».

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: «أولئك»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «جزاؤهم مغفرة» is khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «من ربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مغفرة». His saying «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «جزاؤهم», accusative with the yāʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to «خالدين». The clause «ونعم أجر العاملين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: The clause «فسيروا» is resumptive. His saying «كيف»: an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and it suspends (muʿalliq) «انظروا». And the clause «كيف كان عاقبة» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «انظروا», which is made to include the sense of «اعلموا» (know).

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بيان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «للمتقين» is attached to a naʿt of «موعظة».

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: The clause «وأنتم الأعلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and the clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: «الأيام» is a badal (substitute), and the clause «نداولها» is the khabar (predicate) of «تلك». His saying «وليعلم الله»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن», optionally implied; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e.: We alternate them so that He may know. The clause «وتلك الأيام نداولها» is resumptive. The implied clause «نداولها» is conjoined to the preceding clause «نداولها». The clause «والله لا يحب الظالمين» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: His saying «وليمحص الله»: the imperfect verb is accusative by an implied «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar {وَلِيَعْلَمَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, implied as «بل» plus the hamza; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تدخلوا» takes the place of the two objects of «حسب»; the wāw is circumstantial; «لمَّا» is a jussive-governing particle. His saying «ويعلم»: the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and the verb is accusative by «أن», necessarily implied after the wāw of accompaniment; and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: and there is not yet knowledge of who strove and knowledge of who was patient.

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: The clause «ولقد كنتم تمنون» is conjoined to the preceding clause {حَسِبْتُمْ}. The clause «لقد كنتم» is the answer to the oath, and the clause «تلقوه» is the ṣila of the relative particle. And the clause «وأنتم تنظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negating and inoperative because its negation is broken by «إلا». «محمد» is mubtadaʾ (subject), «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «رسول» is khabar (predicate), nominative; the clause «قد خلت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسول». The clause «أفإن مات» is conjoined to the clause «وما محمد إلا رسول», with no grammatical position. The clause «ومن ينقلب» is resumptive. «شيئاً» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause «وسيجزي الله» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تموت» is the noun of «كان», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «تموت». His saying «كتاباً»: an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «كتب ذلك كتاباً» (He wrote that as a writing). His saying «من يرد»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «وسنجزي الشاكرين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: The wāw is resumptive; «كأيِّن» is an allusive noun (kināya) for "many", mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition and its genitive noun «من نبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of «كأيِّن». «كأيِّن» stands in for an indefinite noun; therefore the semi-clause after it is attached to a naʿt of «كأين». The clause «قاتل معه ربيون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The clause «فما وهنوا» is conjoined to the clause «قاتل». And the clause «والله يحب الصابرين» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, because His saying in the following verse {وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ} is conjoined to the clause «وما استكانوا».

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن قالوا» is the postponed noun of «كان», and the preposition and its genitive noun «في أمرنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (إسرافنا).

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: «ثواب» is the second object, and the clause «فآتاهم» is conjoined to the clause «انصرنا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: The conditional clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «خاسرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تنقلبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: «بل»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb), and the clause «وهو خير» is conjoined to the clause «الله مولاكم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: His saying «بما أشركوا»: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سنلقي», the implied form being: because of their associating partners. His saying «ما لم ينزل»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «ومأواهم النار» is conjoined to the clause «سنلقي», with no grammatical position; and the clause «وبئس مثوى» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: «النار» (the Fire).

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: His saying «إذ تحُّسّونهم»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صدقكم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذنه» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تحسونهم», and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. His saying «حتى إذا فشلتم»: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and «إذا» is adverbial, attached to its implied apodosis: «انقسمتم» (you were divided). The conditional clause is resumptive. His saying «من بعد ما أراكم»: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: after His showing you. The clause «منكم من يريد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «والله ذو فضل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: «إذ تصعدون»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر»; the clause «والرسول يدعوكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. The preposition and its genitive noun «في أخراكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يدعوكم». His saying «لكيلا»: the lām is a preposition, and «كي» is accusative-governing and maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to «أثابكم». And the clause «والله خبير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t:
54 - {ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُعَاسًا يَغْشَى طَائِفَةً مِنْكُمْ وَطَائِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ ظَنَّ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ لَنَا مِنَ الأَمْرِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ قُلْ إِنَّ الأَمْرَ كُلَّهُ لِلَّهِ يُخْفُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ مَا لا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ مَا قُتِلْنَا هَاهُنَا قُلْ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ الَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَتْلُ إِلَى مَضَاجِعِهِمْ وَلِيَبْتَلِيَ اللَّهُ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ} [Translator's note: the source numbers this verse "54"; it is verse 154.]
His saying «نعاساً»: an accusative badal (substitute), and the clause «يغشى» is a naʿt (adjective), in the position of the accusative. His saying «وطائفة قد أهمتهم»: the wāw is circumstantial, and «طائفة» is mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it relies on the wāw and on the implied qualification, i.e.: and a party other than you. The clause «قد أهمتهم» is khabar (predicate) of «طائفة», and the clause «يظنون» is a second khabar of «طائفة»; the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يظنون»; and the clause «قل إن الأمر كله لله» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. The clause «يخفون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of «يقولون», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of «يخفون». His saying «غير الحق»: first object, the implied form being: they think other than the truth to be about Allah; and His saying «ظن الجاهلية»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). His saying «هل لنا من الأمر من شيء»: «هل» is interrogative, «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, the preposition and its genitive noun «من الأمر» is attached to a ḥāl of «من شيء», «شيء» is mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). His saying «وليبتلي»: an imperfect verb, accusative by «أن», optionally implied after the lām of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to an implied verb, i.e.: and He prescribed fighting so that He might test. His saying «وليمحّص»: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن», and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, the implied form being: He prescribed for the testing and the purging; and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun «هو».

harrat-mujtaba:155-155.t: The clause «استزلَّهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause «ولقد عفا الله» is resumptive; the clause «لقد عفا» is the answer to an implied oath; and the clause «إن الله غفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: «إذا ضربوا»: purely adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا». His saying «ليجعل»: the lām is causal, and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by an implied «أن», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to the implied verb «أوقع» (He brought about); and the implied clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (al-mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and «إن» is conditional; the clause «لمغفرة خير» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: The clause «لإلى الله تحشرون» is the answer to the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تحشرون».

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and «رحمة» is a genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لنت». The fāʾ in His saying «فاعف عنهم» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «شاورهم».

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: His saying «فمن ذا الذي»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), «ذا» is a demonstrative, its khabar (predicate), and «الذي» is a badal (substitute). His saying «وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون»: the wāw is resumptive, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتوكل», the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the lām is for command, the imperfect is jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn, and «المؤمنون» is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause «فليتوكل المؤمنون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يَغُلّ» is the postponed noun of «كان»; «مَنْ» in His saying «ومن يغلل» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: The hamza is for interrogation, «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «كمن» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «ومأواه جهنم» is conjoined to the clause «باء», with no grammatical position; the clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e.: «جهنم» (Hell).

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: «عند الله» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «درجات».

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: The clause «لقد منَّ الله» is the answer to an implied oath; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مَنَّ»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أنفسهم» is attached to «رسولا». The clause «وإن كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «يعلِّمهم»; «إن» is lightened from the heavy form, and the lām after it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa).

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: The hamza is for interrogation; it comes before the wāw because interrogation takes the head of the clause; the wāw is resumptive, and «لمّا» is a particle of consequence upon consequence. «مثليها» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is dual. His saying «أنّى هذا»: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place meaning "from where", attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate), and the demonstrative is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «التقى الجمعان» is muḍāf ilayhi. The fāʾ in His saying «فبإذن» occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: «فهو بإذن الله» (then it is by Allah's leave). His saying «وليعلم»: the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن», optionally implied after the lām of causation. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to something implied, i.e.: He did that; and this implied element is conjoined to the clause «وما أصابكم».

harrat-mujtaba:167-167.t: «تعالوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «قاتلوا» is a badal (substitute) of the clause «تعالوا», in the position of the accusative; and the clause «هم أقرب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His saying «يومئذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقرب», and «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and its tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted clause. The two preposition and its genitive nouns «منهم للإيمان» are attached to «أقرب». And the preposition and its genitive noun «بأفواههم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يقولون».

harrat-mujtaba:168-168.t: The clause «فادرءوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful, then avert.

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: «بل»: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); «أحياء» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هم أحياء» (they are alive), and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحياء»; the clause «بل هم أحياء» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the clause «يرزقون» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: His saying «فرحين بما آتاهم»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {يُرْزَقُونَ}, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرحين». His saying «ألا خوف»: «أن» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). «لا» is negating, operating like laysa, and the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم» are attached to the khabar (predicate) of «لا»; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) of «الذين لم يلحقوا», i.e.: they rejoice at their having no fear; and the clause «ولا هم يحزنون» is conjoined to the clause «لا خوف عليهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الله» is conjoined to «نعمة», i.e.: they rejoice at a favour and at their reward not being lost.

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: The clause «للذين أحسنوا أجر» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «أحسنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: The clause «فاخشوهم» is conjoined to the clause «قد جمعوا», in the position of the nominative. The clause «فزادهم» is conjoined to the clause «قال», with no grammatical position; «إيمانا» is the second object. His saying «حسبنا الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); and the clause «ونعم الوكيل» is conjoined to the clause «حسبنا الله», and the one specified for praise is omitted, i.e. «الله».

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: The clause «لم يمسسهم» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «انقلبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: «إنما»: the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no grammatical position; «ذا» is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām is for distance, and the kāf for address. «الشيطان»: khabar (predicate), nominative; and the clause «يخوّف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشيطان». The clause «فلا تخافوهم» is conjoined to the clause «إنما ذلكم الشيطان», and the clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:176-176.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في الكفر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسارعون», on the basis of its being made to include the sense of «يقعون» (they fall). The clause «إنهم لن يضروا» is resumptive; «شيئا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a harm, little or much; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا يجعل» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition and its genitive noun «لهم» is attached to the second object of «يجعل»; the clause «يريد الله» is parenthetical. The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لن يضروا».

harrat-mujtaba:177-177.t: The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لن يضروا».

harrat-mujtaba:178-178.t: His saying «أنّما نملي لهم خير»: «أنّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), «ما» is a relative noun, its noun; and «أنّ» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that takes the place of the two objects of «حسب». His saying «إنما نملي لهم ليزدادوا إثمًا»: «إنما» is the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no grammatical position. «نملي»: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma because of heaviness, and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun «نحن». «ليزدادوا»: an imperfect, accusative by an implied «أن», and the maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نملي». «ازداد» in the pattern «افتعل» is intransitive, and «إثمًا» is tamyīz (specification). And the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the second clause «نملي».

harrat-mujtaba:179-179.t: «ما كان الله ليذر»: the lām is the lām of denial (al-juḥūd), and the verb is accusative by «أن», necessarily implied after the lām of denial; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «كان», «مريداً» (intending).

harrat-mujtaba:180-180.t: «هو خيرًا»: «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), with no grammatical position; «خيرًا» is the second object of «يحسبنّ». The first is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: «بخلهم» (their stinginess). The clause «بل هو شر» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «سيطوقون».

harrat-mujtaba:181-181.t: His saying «وقتلهم الأنبياء بغير حق»: the wāw is a conjunction; «قتلهم» is a noun conjoined to «ما», accusative; «الأنبياء» is the object of the maṣdar (verbal noun) «قتل»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «قتلهم».

harrat-mujtaba:182-182.t: His saying «وأنّ الله ليس بظلام للعبيد»: the wāw is a conjunction, «أنّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), and «الله» is its noun. «ليس» is an abrogating verb, its noun is the pronoun «هو», the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and «ظَلام» is a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of laysa; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to «ما». «للعبيد»: the lām is redundant, for strengthening, since the governing word became weak when it became secondary to the verb, so it was strengthened by the lām; and «العبيد» is a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:183-183.t: His saying «ألا نؤمن»: «أن» governs the accusative, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition «في». «فلِمَ قتلتموهم»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you are truthful, then why did you kill them? The lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive; its alif was elided because the preposition is attached to it; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قتلتموهم».

harrat-mujtaba:184-184.t: The clause «جاءوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسل».

harrat-mujtaba:185-185.t: The clause «وإنما توفَّون» is resumptive, and the clause «فمن زحزح» is conjoined to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:186-186.t: His saying «لتُبلوُنَّ»: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; the original form is «لتُبلَوُونَنَّ»: the first nūn was elided because of the gathering of like letters, the ḍamma on the first wāw was found heavy and was dropped, so two vowelless letters met and the final radical (lām al-kalima) was elided, and the wāw of the plural was given a ḍamma to indicate the elided letter; the verb is a passive imperfect, nominative by the presence of the elided nūn, the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the nūn is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:187-187.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر». «أوتوا»: a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «الكتاب» is the second object. «لتُبَيِّنُنَّه»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn, which was elided because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent); the nūn has no grammatical position, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. His saying «فبئس ما يشترون»: the fāʾ is resumptive, the verb is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb of blame, «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil, and the one specified is omitted, i.e.: «شراؤهم» (their purchase).

harrat-mujtaba:188-188.t: His saying «فلا تحسبنَّهم بمفازة»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the verb is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the preceding verb «لا تحسبن», repeated because of the length of what separates them; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The clause «لا تحسبنهم» is conjoined to the clause «لا تحسبن». And the clause «ولهم عذاب أليم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «تحسبنهم».

harrat-mujtaba:189-189.t: The clause «والله على كل شيء قدير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:190-190.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لأولي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:191-191.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «أولي الألباب», in the position of the genitive. «قياماً»: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial). The preposition and its genitive noun «وعلى جنوبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl, i.e.: being on their sides, meaning lying down; and this interpreted ḥāl is conjoined to the explicit one. The clause «ربنا» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e.: they say, «ربنا», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl clause. «باطلا» is ḥāl; the clause «سبحانك» is parenthetical, and it stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. And the clause «فقنا» is conjoined to the response to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:192-192.t: «من» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». His saying «وما للظالمين من أنصار»: the wāw is circumstantial, «ما» is negating and inoperative, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, «من» is redundant (zāʾida), «أنصار» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:193-193.t: «أن آمنوا»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «آمنوا» is explicative. And the clause «ربنا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:194-194.t: The clause «ربنا» is parenthetical; the clause «وآتنا» is conjoined to the clause «توفَّنا».

harrat-mujtaba:195-195.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنِّي لا أضيع» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ. His saying «ثواباً»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governing word, its implied form being «لأثيبنهم» (I shall surely reward them). The clause «لأكفرن» is the answer to an implied oath, and the oath with its answer is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». And the clause «عنده حسن الثواب» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:196-196.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في البلاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (تقلب).

harrat-mujtaba:197-197.t: «متاع» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «تقلُّبهم متاع» (their movement is an enjoyment), «قليل» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is resumptive. «ثمّ» is a conjunction, «مأواهم» is mubtadaʾ, «جهنم» is its khabar, and the clause is conjoined to the resumptive one. The clause «وبئس المهاد» is resumptive, and the one specified is omitted, i.e.: «جهنم» (Hell).

harrat-mujtaba:198-198.t: «لكن» is an inoperative particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the clause «لهم جنات» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». «نزلا من عند الله»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We lodge them a lodging; and the preposition and its genitive noun «من عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نزلا». His saying «وما عند الله»: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the adverb is attached to the ṣila (relative clause). «خير»: khabar, nominative, and the preposition and its genitive noun after it is attached to it.

harrat-mujtaba:199-199.t: His saying «لمن يؤمن»: the lām is for emphasis, and «من» is a relative noun, the noun of «إنَّ». The clause «لا يشترون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يؤمن». The clause «أولئك لهم أجرهم» is resumptive. And the clause «لهم أجرهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:200-200.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي», and the clause «اصبروا» is the response to the vocative, with no grammatical position. The clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
